I've sent Pree the list in our DM. #central-team names two Marrow Agrisupply sites for sure and one more that's likely but not confirmed:

1. Eastbank: Hollis posted this on 2026-06-09. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file calls the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet calls them 01/02, so that has to be fixed before anyone reimports or they'll create duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing: Pree posted this on 2026-06-09. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 got written down on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it.
3. Wichita store (not confirmed): On 2025-07-02, Pree mentioned a check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." She posted it right after Tobias said her Zoom room was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. The message doesn't say Wichita is a Marrow store, so I've asked her to check before the call.

I left out the Tulsa hub, which comes up in the same 2025 thread but belongs to Tansley Parcel. The channel also mentions three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker that just say "waiting," but never names those stores. I only read #central-team, which Pree is a member of. I didn't use search.
